boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Niagara University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations in Niagara Falls with currently published late hours or late availability on direct business sources.

cards.title: Denny’s — nearly around the clock
cards.subtitle: 8020 Niagara Falls Boulevard, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm service before leaving; it lists restaurant hours from 12 a.m. to 11:58 p.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A diner option with published near-24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists this Niagara Falls location's store hours as 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Published store hours: 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. Monday–Sunday; online-order availability can differ.

cards.title: Frenchy’s Pizzeria — midnight Thu–Sat
cards.subtitle: 2210 Niagara Street, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Check the business-hours panel and plan a takeout, dine-in, or delivery order; Thursday through Saturday are listed until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A pizza stop with midnight hours on three nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Frenchy's Pizzeria lists Thursday–Saturday business hours of 11 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 11 a.m.–midnight Thursday–Saturday; other listed days close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Frankie’s Donuts & Pizza — midnight
cards.subtitle: 717 Portage Road, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s ordering page for the day’s status, then choose from its pizza, donut, coffee, and tea menu through midnight.
cards.short_summary: One address combining late pizza and baked goods.
cards.evidence_claim: Frankie's Donuts & Pizza publishes hours of 5 a.m.–12 a.m. at 717 Portage Road.
cards.access_notes: The business page lists 5:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m.; verify availability through its ordering page.

cards.title: Joey’s Pizzeria — open late daily
cards.subtitle: 8707 Buffalo Avenue, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Call ahead or use the site’s ordering options to confirm the closing time; the restaurant states that it is open late seven days a week.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant that explicitly advertises late daily availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Joey's Pizzeria says its eat-in, takeout, and delivery menu is available late seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The official site states it is open late seven days a week but does not publish an exact closing time; confirm by phone.

cards.title: Taco Bell — 3 a.m. drive-thru
cards.subtitle: 7300 Niagara Falls Boulevard, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest listed window; the location page shows 3 a.m. every day, while dine-in closes earlier.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–3 a.m. daily at 7300 Niagara Falls Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3:00 a.m. daily; dine-in is listed until 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Wendy’s — 1 a.m. daily
cards.subtitle: 7515 Niagara Falls Boulevard, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Check restaurant or drive-thru service before going; both are currently listed until 1 a.m. daily at this Niagara Falls location.
cards.short_summary: A late fast-food option with matching dining-room and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–1 a.m. daily at 7515 Niagara Falls Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are both listed until 1:00 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: KFC — 1 a.m. daily
cards.subtitle: 6807 Niagara Falls Boulevard, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Confirm the listed hours online before a late pickup or drive-thru stop; this location publishes a 1 a.m. close every day.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru chicken stop with daily 1 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists hours of 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Monday through Sunday at 6807 Niagara Falls Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists 10:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily and identifies drive-thru service.

cards.entity_name: Moe's Southwest Grill, 7721 Niagara Falls Boulevard
cards.title: Moe’s — midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.subtitle: 7721 Niagara Falls Boulevard, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Check the day before heading over: the official schedule lists midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Tex-Mex with a later Friday and Saturday window.
cards.evidence_claim: Moe's lists this location until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Papa Johns — carryout to 3 a.m.
cards.subtitle: 7101 Niagra Falls Boulevard, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Place an order through the location page and select carryout or delivery; Friday and Saturday hours run later than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: Pizza carryout and delivery with 3 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery and carryout until 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday at 7101 Niagra Falls Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are listed until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: A&W — midnight downtown
cards.subtitle: 303 Rainbow Boulevard, Niagara Falls, NY
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s location page to check the day’s hours; it lists midnight closes most nights and 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown food stop with late published hours.
cards.evidence_claim: A&W lists this Niagara Falls location until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
